title: The Cypress/PSoC6 flash-map backend in boot/cypress/cy_flash_pal/cy_flash_map.c guards every flash access with…
description: CVE-2026-16667 is a vulnerability in the Cypress/PSoC6 flash-map backend where flash access functions incorrectly validate offsets against the partition base address instead of the partition size. This allows out-of-bounds reads during image validation if an attacker stages a crafted update image with oversized fields. The out-of-bounds read can cause the bootloader to crash or hang due to accessing unmapped memory, resulting in a denial-of-service. No memory corruption, information disclosure, or authentication bypass occurs. The issue is specific to the Cypress/PSoC6 port and does not affect other backends.
